romaji: Tenki ga ii desu kara, dokoka e ikimasen ka.
english: Since the weather is nice, would you like to go somewhere?
exampleRomaji: Tenki ga yoi desu kara, dokoka e ikimasen ka.
japaneseFurigana: 天気(てんき)がいいですから、どこかへ行(い)きませんか。
exampleEn: Since the weather is nice, would you like to go somewhere?
audioPath: clips/001_天気が良いですから、どこかへ行きませんか.wav
grammar2:
〜から = because/since
〜ませんか = shall we...

romaji: Watashi wa, atarashii kaban ga hoshii desu.
english: I want a new bag.
exampleRomaji: Watashi wa, atarashii kaban ga hoshii desu.
japaneseFurigana: 私(わたし)は、新(あたら)しいかばんがほしいです。
exampleEn: I want a new bag.
audioPath: clips/002_私は、新しいカバンが欲しいです。.wav
grammar2:
新(あたら)しい (new) ↔ 古(ふる)い (old)
〜がほしい = want something

romaji: Doko e kai ni ikimasu ka.
english: Where will you go to buy it?
exampleRomaji: Doko e kai ni ikimasu ka.
japaneseFurigana: どこへ買(か)いに行(い)きますか。
exampleEn: Where will you go to buy it?
audioPath: clips/003_どこへ買いに行きますか.wav
grammar2:
買(か)う (to buy)
行(い)く (to go)

romaji: Eki no mae no depaato e kai ni ikimasu.
english: I will go to the department store in front of the station to buy it.
exampleRomaji: Eki no mae no depaato e kai ni ikimasu.
japaneseFurigana: 駅(えき)の前(まえ)のデパートへ買(か)いに行(い)きます。
exampleEn: I will go to the department store in front of the station to buy it.
audioPath: clips/004_駅の前のデパートへ買いに行きます。.wav
grammar2:
前(まえ) (front) ↔ 後(うし)ろ (back)
行(い)く (to go)

romaji: Don'na kaban ga hoshii desu ka.
english: What kind of bag do you want?
exampleRomaji: Don'na kaban ga hoshii desu ka.
japaneseFurigana: どんなかばんがほしいですか。
exampleEn: What kind of bag do you want?
audioPath: clips/005_どんなカバンが欲しいですか.wav
grammar2: どんな = what kind of

romaji: Watashi wa, ookii kaban ga hoshii desu.
english: I want a big bag.
exampleRomaji: Watashi wa, ookii kaban ga hoshii desu.
japaneseFurigana: 私(わたし)は、大(おお)きいかばんがほしいです。
exampleEn: I want a big bag.
audioPath: clips/006_私は、大きいカバンが欲しいです。.wav
grammar2: 大(おお)きい (big) ↔ 小(ちい)さい (small)

romaji: Atarashii kaban ni nani o iremasu ka.
english: What will you put in your new bag?
exampleRomaji: Atarashii kaban ni nani o iremasu ka.
japaneseFurigana: 新(あたら)しいかばんに何(なに)を入(い)れますか。
exampleEn: What will you put in your new bag?
audioPath: clips/007_新しいカバンに何を入れますか.wav
grammar2: 入(い)れる (to put in) ↔ 出(だ)す (to take out)

romaji: Jisho ya kyoukasho o takusan iremasu.
english: I will put a lot of dictionaries and textbooks in it.
exampleRomaji: Jisho ya kyoukasho o takusan iremasu.
japaneseFurigana: 辞書(じしょ)や教科書(きょうかしょ)をたくさん入(い)れます。
exampleEn: I will put a lot of dictionaries and textbooks in it.
audioPath: clips/008_辞書や教科書をたくさん入れます。.wav
grammar2:
〜や〜 = and
たくさん = a lot

romaji: Omoi nimotsu desu ne.
english: That's heavy luggage, isn't it?
exampleRomaji: Omoi nimotsu desu ne.
japaneseFurigana: 重(おも)い荷物(にもつ)ですね。
exampleEn: That's heavy luggage, isn't it?
audioPath: clips/009_重い荷物ですね。.wav
grammar2:
重(おも)い (heavy) ↔ 軽(かる)い (light)
荷物(にもつ) = luggage

romaji: Desu kara, tsuyoi kaban ga hoshii desu. Don'na iro ga hoshii desu ka.
english: So, I want a strong bag. What color do you want?
exampleRomaji: Desu kara, joubu na kaban ga hoshii desu. Don'na iro ga hoshii desu ka.
japaneseFurigana: ですから、強(つよ)いかばんがほしいです。どんな色(いろ)がほしいですか。
exampleEn: So, I want a sturdy bag. What color do you want?
audioPath: clips/010_ですから、強いカバンが欲しいです。どんな色が欲しいですか.wav
grammar2:
ですから = therefore
強(つよ)い (strong) ↔ 弱(よわ)い (weak)

romaji: Watashi wa kuroi iro ga ii desu.
english: I prefer the color black.
exampleRomaji: Watashi wa kuroi iro ga ii desu.
japaneseFurigana: 私(わたし)は黒(くろ)い色(いろ)がいいです。
exampleEn: I prefer the color black.
audioPath: clips/011_私は黒い色がいいです。.wav
grammar2:
色(いろ) = color
〜がいい = prefer

romaji: Kuroi kaban wa, kakkoii desu ne.
english: Black bags look cool, don't they?
exampleRomaji: Kuroi kaban wa, kakkoii desu ne.
japaneseFurigana: 黒(くろ)いかばんは、かっこいいですね。
exampleEn: Black bags look cool, don't they?
audioPath: clips/012_黒いカバンは、かっこいいですね。.wav
grammar2: 黒(くろ)い (black) ↔ 白(しろ)い (white)

romaji: Mainichi, gakkou e motte ikitai desu.
english: I want to take it to school every day.
exampleRomaji: Mainichi, gakkou e motte ikitai desu.
japaneseFurigana: 毎日(まいにち)、学校(がっこう)へ持(も)って行(い)きたいです。
exampleEn: I want to take it to school every day.
audioPath: clips/013_毎日、学校へ持って行きたいです。.wav
grammar2:
持(も)って行(い)く = to take
〜たい = want to do

romaji: Depaato ni wa, kutsu no mise mo arimasu yo.
english: Department stores also have shoe shops, you know.
exampleRomaji: Depaato ni wa, kutsu no mise mo arimasu yo.
japaneseFurigana: デパートには、靴(くつ)の店(みせ)もありますよ。
exampleEn: Department stores also have shoe shops, you know.
audioPath: clips/014_デパートには、靴の店もありますよ。.wav
grammar2: 店(みせ) = shop

romaji: Watashi wa, kutsu mo hoshii desu.
english: I want shoes too.
exampleRomaji: Watashi wa, kutsu mo hoshii desu.
japaneseFurigana: 私(わたし)は、靴(くつ)もほしいです。
exampleEn: I want shoes too.
audioPath: clips/015_私は、靴も欲しいです。.wav
grammar2: 靴(くつ) = shoes

romaji: Donna kutsu ga hoshii desu ka.
english: What kind of shoes would you like?
exampleRomaji: Donna kutsu ga hoshii desu ka.
japaneseFurigana: どんな靴(くつ)がほしいですか。
exampleEn: What kind of shoes would you like?
audioPath: clips/016_どんな靴が欲しいですか.wav
grammar2: 靴(くつ) = shoes

romaji: Watashi wa, karui kutsu ga hoshii desu.
english: I want lightweight shoes.
exampleRomaji: Watashi wa, karui kutsu ga hoshii desu.
japaneseFurigana: 私(わたし)は、軽(かる)い靴(くつ)がほしいです。
exampleEn: I want lightweight shoes.
audioPath: clips/017_私は、軽い靴が欲しいです。.wav
grammar2: 軽(かる)い (light) ↔ 重(おも)い (heavy)

romaji: Sanpo no toki ni ii desu ne.
english: They would be great for walking, wouldn't they?
exampleRomaji: Sanpo no toki ni ii desu ne.
japaneseFurigana: 散歩(さんぽ)の時(とき)にいいですね。
exampleEn: They would be great for walking, wouldn't they?
audioPath: clips/018_散歩の時に良いですね。.wav
grammar2:
散歩(さんぽ) = walk
時(とき) = time

romaji: Mainichi, takusan arukitai desu kara.
english: Because I want to walk a lot every day.
exampleRomaji: Mainichi, takusan arukitai desu kara.
japaneseFurigana: 毎日(まいにち)、たくさん歩(ある)きたいですから。
exampleEn: Because I want to walk a lot every day.
audioPath: clips/019_毎日、たくさん歩きたいですから。.wav
grammar2: 歩(ある)く (to walk)

romaji: Jaa, kyou depaato e, kutsu mo mini ikimashou.
english: Well then, let's go to the department store today to look at shoes too.
exampleRomaji: Jaa, kyou depaato e, kutsu mo mini ikimashou.
japaneseFurigana: じゃあ、今日(きょう)デパートへ、靴(くつ)も見(み)に行(い)きましょう。
exampleEn: Well then, let's go to the department store today to look at shoes too.
audioPath: clips/020_じゃあ、今日デパートへ、靴も見に行きましょう。.wav
grammar2:
今日(きょう) = today
見(み)に行(い)く = go to see

romaji: Kyou no kaimono wa, totemo tanoshimi desu.
english: I'm really looking forward to today's shopping.
exampleRomaji: Kyou no kaimono wa, totemo tanoshimi desu.
japaneseFurigana: 今日(きょう)の買(か)い物(もの)は、とても楽(たの)しみです。
exampleEn: I'm really looking forward to today's shopping.
audioPath: clips/021_今日の買い物は、とても楽しみです。.wav
grammar2:
買(か)い物(もの) = shopping
楽(たの)しみ = looking forward to

romaji: Watashi wa, depaato de oishii okashi o kaitai desu.
english: I want to buy some delicious sweets at the department store.
exampleRomaji: Watashi wa, depaato de oishii okashi o kaitai desu.
japaneseFurigana: 私(わたし)は、デパートでおいしいお菓子(かし)を買(か)いたいです。
exampleEn: I want to buy some delicious sweets at the department store.
audioPath: clips/022_私は、デパートで美味しいお菓子を買いたいです。.wav
grammar2:
お菓子(かし) = sweets
買(か)う = to buy

romaji: Kaimono no ato de, issho ni tabemashou.
english: Let's eat together after shopping.
exampleRomaji: Kaimono no ato de, issho ni tabemashou.
japaneseFurigana: 買(か)い物(もの)の後(あと)で、一(いっ)緒(しょ)に食(た)べましょう。
exampleEn: Let's eat together after shopping.
audioPath: clips/023_買い物の後で、一緒に食べましょう。.wav
grammar2:
後(あと)で = after
一(いっ)緒(しょ)に = together

romaji: Sugu ni eki e ikimashou.
english: Let's go to the station right away.
exampleRomaji: Sugu ni eki e ikimashou.
japaneseFurigana: すぐに駅(えき)へ行(い)きましょう。
exampleEn: Let's go to the station right away.
